theorems.name: Submission.fderiv_fderiv_symm_of_contDiffOn_two
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ v w : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x w v
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
